column1: # Partition table for the Monitor.
# 8 MB flash with two app slots and the bootloader's rollback
# written over the air can be undone without a cable; see ADR-0006. A slot is
# 1.875 MB against an app of about 1.16 MB today
# bundle and mbedtls come out of that headroom. An app that ever outgrows a
# slot needs another partition table
column2: which is another USB flash - so the

column1: # margin is a number to watch and not a number to spend.
# Everything left over is the capture store: 4.125 MB
# ride writes on both links is about ninety minutes. That is sized above the
# forty minutes a ride is expected to need
column2: because when the store fills it is

column1: # the tail that is lost
column2: and the tail is the low State of Charge part that the

column1: # Consumption and Usable Capacity work needs most.

column2: so its old contents became unreachable and it reformatted on

column1: # the first boot: every Capture had to be off the board before that flash. A
# partition table cannot be replaced over the air
column2: so that was the last cable.
